Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new production identity painting for The Apprentice's Notebook: Tess, the Tuner. Slim bell-tuning apprentice with a tall upright topknot, a long soft scarf with one broad tail hanging away from the torso, and a long-handled heavy bronze tuning fork raised upright at shoulder height. The fork is visibly Y-shaped, two stout open prongs, a clear gap of transparent air around fork and shoulder. Put fork next to the face, fork tips approximately level with the forehead and below the topknot. Compact work jacket in warm bronze olive, restrained rose scarf accent.
Image 1 shows the three APPROVED neighboring characters, an ensemble reference only for body proportions, camera, finish and scale. Invent this identity according to the subject description. Output one person only. Image 2 is a clean crop for matte paint and lighting. Image 3 is the palette strip: district dark/mid/light #292A2A #6F6956 #B19060; then the small clothing accent #A8324C; then the city night colors #1F2A3A #3A4148 #5D666D #A9BCC6. Hold these swatches' color saturation in the major masses and keep warm colored lamplight over cool cloth. Match the style, proportions and finish of the attached approved anchors.
Composition: one standing complete head-to-boots sprite cutout at the largest available native portrait dimensions (2:3 if possible). High 3/4 tactics camera, from slightly above, facing screen right like the references. Foreshorten tops of head and boots. Fit both boots fully in-frame, centered and planted with the feet close to the bottom-center baseline, leaving narrow transparent margins all around. When fitted on the 128×176 game canvas the body reads at about 1.3 cells. Real RGBA transparency around every edge and between limbs and props. There is no ground, no backdrop or visible checkerboard, no contact shadow, no baked shadow, and no side rim light. Sparse engraved edge marks with clean outer contour and fine paint grain, simplified forms. Silhouette key that must survive at 24 px in greyscale: Tall exposed topknot above a narrow silhouette, large two-pronged tuning fork proud of the shoulder, and a long offset scarf tail.
No glyphs, seals with symbols, pseudo-lettering, insignia, flags, border, ground, shadow or matte fringe. Do not use any reference character as the output. Painted 2D game art, broad matte gouache-like value masses, fine paint grain, sparse engraved ink detail at material edges. Light from the upper left. Warm lamp light against cold blue night; wet surfaces catch small highlights. Soft distant detail. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no frames, no arrows, no grid lines, no reach dots, no health bars, no targeting rings, no watermark.
